title: extract-claims output
description: Every claim a paper makes, one self-contained sentence each, typed, graded by strength and cited. Keys are unique (C1, C2, ...); a measured claim cites a results or experiments passage, a table or a figure (checked by app.papers.checks).

key.description: C1, C2, ... in reading order, unique within the set.

text.description: The claim as one self-contained sentence a reader of another paper can understand.

strength.description: measured: backed by the paper's own experiments or data; argued: supported by reasoning, proof or citation; speculated: hedged, hypothesised or left to future work.
